summary: Replaced narrow per-apply* persist with a tail-of-handleUpdate persist that splits into synchronous-apply branches (persist directly) and invalidate-deferred branches (switch to invalidateAndAwait and chain persist via .then); added Risk Area #8, two new acceptance criteria, and a new sync.test.ts case asserting persist is deferred until the invalidate promise resolves.

Committed onReconnected design (invalidate iff stored lastSeenSeq is undefined) in Approach, mirrored it in Files-to-Modify sync.ts bullet and Scope, and split the acceptance test into two spy-based assertions covering both branches; updated Open Questions §3 to mark the decision as resolved.

Plan already addresses the finding in full: BufferedUpdate includes recipientFilter and createdAt; a private doesFilterMatchConnection helper mirroring getRoomsForFilter is specified with the exact per-filter-type mapping the finding requests; replay loop emits only filter-matched entries; the connection is passed from socket.ts; test (d) covers the connection-type × filter-type matrix; Risk #4 enforces the helper/getRoomsForFilter lockstep invariant. The 'recipientFilterFromConnection' string referenced in the finding's description does not appear in the current plan.

Storage setLastSeenUpdateSeq is now specified as monotonic via Math.max with central guard for all callers; added Risk #9 describing the async out-of-order race and a dedicated acceptance-criteria test asserting that writing seq 10 then seq 6 leaves stored value at 10 and skips the regressing MMKV write.
Agent failed to emit <review-meta> for F-005 on 2 consecutive iterations; finding auto-marked wont_fix

Documented the one-user-per-daemon invariant (empirical basis: dualListenerBinding.ts pinning + pair-protocol gating) as the precondition that licenses per-user cap-overflow math given global allocateUserSeq; added Risk #10, Technical-constraints bullet, CLAUDE.md update requirement, inline-comment requirement at module-scoped maps, Open Question follow-up, and explicit trim-watermark/per-account-refactor escape hatch if the invariant is ever relaxed.
